subject.title: Agent陷入工具调用失败死循环，导致重复发送消息刷屏

question: Should OpenClaw turn tool-validation and no-progress loop protection into a default-on core safety policy, and what default thresholds and user-visible failure message should it use?
rationale: Current code has partial opt-in guardrails, but changing defaults and blocking model tool calls affects existing workflows and channel-visible behavior, so automation should not choose the permanent product policy alone.

options.title: Default-On Conservative Guard
options.body: Enable a narrow default guard for deterministic validation errors and repeated identical no-progress outcomes, with a clear terminal message and focused regression coverage.

options.title: Keep Opt-In Detection
options.body: Leave rolling loop detection off by default and document `tools.loopDetection.enabled`, accepting that default installs can still repeat until other run limits intervene.

options.title: Defer To Broader Circuit Breaker Design
options.body: Keep this issue open under a larger circuit-breaker/self-healing plan before changing defaults or channel-visible behavior.

recommendation.title: Default-On Conservative Guard
recommendation.body: Enable a narrow default guard for deterministic validation errors and repeated identical no-progress outcomes, with a clear terminal message and focused regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current default-off configuration behavior and docs trace to steipete's configurable loop detection work, making this the best available routing owner for the product-default decision.
